In `OptimizeGloballyPopupExpertBatch.java`, the introduction of the `isSavedFaG` variable allows for a clearer and more maintainable check on whether the saved filtering and grouping data is `null`. The subsequent action of setting `savedFilteringAndGrouping` to `null` after the optimization process is completed ensures that the data is only discarded when it is no longer needed, thus preventing any potential bugs related to the asynchronous nature of the global optimization. 

Overall, these changes work together to fix the bug related to the handling of `SpimDataFilteringAndGrouping` during asynchronous global optimization.
